name: ynab-mcp
description: A secure, self-hosted YNAB MCP server for Claude and ChatGPT, running on Cloudflare Workers.

YNAB_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Your YNAB personal access token. Create one at https://app.ynab.com/settings/developer

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: A password of at least 16 characters. You type it on the login page when connecting Claude or ChatGPT. Use a password manager to generate it.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth clients and hashed tokens.
